review_warning: Should not be generalized beyond the local neighborhood

analytical_role: Assesses influence across broader ranges or distributions
systems_modeling_role: Ranks uncertain drivers and interaction effects
review_warning: Requires justified ranges sampling design and interpretation discipline

analytical_role: Checks whether conclusions persist across plausible assumptions
systems_modeling_role: Separates robust conclusions from fragile claims
review_warning: Robustness only applies to tested ranges and model structures

analytical_role: Identifies thresholds reversals and assumption-dependent conclusions
systems_modeling_role: Helps narrow claims and prioritize further data collection
review_warning: Fragility is a warning for interpretation not automatic model rejection
